write_up: You’ve progressed from Team Lead at Sunshine Parcel to Operations Manager at Gulf Coast Fulfillment. This is a common resume pattern: the titles and duties are there, but the work behind them is mostly missing. A recruiter can see you lead 40 people, yet can’t tell what they handle or what you’ve improved, so the resume may not stand out in a pile.

The scanning system line is your best starting model because it names a real change and where it happened. It still leaves your part in the rollout open. Your dates and progression are easy to follow, and Experience is in the right place above Education.

Let’s start with the current Operations Manager role. Tell us what the team handles, what you oversee each day, and one process you improved. Then go back to the scanning system and explain what you helped do.
